name: Western Region Gold Co., Ltd.
summary: Western Region Gold Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in non-ferrous metal mining, smelting, rolling processing, and beneficiation in China. It offers gold concentrates and related products; electrolytic metal carbide and carbide ingots; plating ores; and copper-plated alloys. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Ürümqi, China. Western Region Gold Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Xinjiang NonFerrous Metal Industry (Group) Co.Ltd.
